methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched via WebFetch on 2026-06-18: skedda.com/pricing, deskbird.com/pricing, robinpowered.com/pricing, officernd.com/pricing/hybrid/, gettactic.com/pricing, nibol.com/en/pricing, tribeloo.com/pricing, envoy.com/pricing. Compliance corroborated on dedicated security pages (skedda.com/platform/security, envoy.com/security) and via WebSearch. EUR-denominated plans (Nibol, Tribeloo, OfficeRnD) are reported in their published currency; USD equivalents are NOT synthesized to avoid FX guesses, so monthlyUsd is null for those. Quote-only / contact-sales tiers carry monthlyUsd=null (a null beats a guess). Note on Tribeloo: the published page lists MONTHLY prices (€3.00/€3.75/€4.00) that are LOWER than the YEARLY-tab prices (€3.60/€4.50/€4.80) — annual is more expensive, the reverse of typical SaaS discounting; monthly rates are reported here. accessedAt 2026-06-18.
